display_name: Four items in the Courts (Fees) Regulations, 5767-2007, recorded as typed values with their tests: a definition that cites two rules of regulations that a later instrument cancels, an amendment that cites its power by a subsection number the consolidation of the cited Law does not print, a threshold printed twice with two figures, and a notice that prints an amount beside an item that a suspension treats as cancelled on the notice's publication day, each with a sound control except the threshold; not an encoding of the Regulations
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: a litigant in a civil proceeding who is charged a fee under the Fees Regulations. The row asks no question from the seat because it records four items.

source.note: the deposits are excerpts of whole lines of unofficial consolidations (the Fees Regulations, the 2018 Civil Procedure Regulations and the Courts Law); a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in official/ as cropped images of the lines read with the footer line; no PDF and no full-page image is deposited.
